verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Recovery: Lean states the first clause with a free exponent β constrained by hβ : β ≤ H + 1 - 2κ and by bar hypotheses MeanClass s β (meanBar E_θ), MeanClass s β (meanBar E_z), instead of writing a min. Instantiating β := min(C_* + 0.17, H + 1 - 2κ) discharges hβ, and the bar hypotheses follow from the paper's (9.14) bounds ⟨E_θ⟩_Y, ⟨E_z⟩_Y ∈ M_{C_*+0.17} by MeanClass.mono_exponent, since β ≤ C_* + 0.17; the conclusion is then the display's first clause. gaugeTemporalStage_next_mean is the weaker instance β := C_* + 0.1 that the cycle actually consumes, and ExponentLedger.temporal_mean_gain_identity with completed_mean_gain_eq performs the min arithmetic on the exponents. Two encoding points: (i) the Lean conclusion for the axial component is stated for axialResidual minus temporalAliasState, which is what the paper also means here — its preceding sentence says the changes belong to the class "after subtracting Fax in the axial component"; (ii) the second clause, (P, Jθ, Jz) ∈ S_H, is a separate declaration (temporalStage_debt_mem) rather than a conjunct of the first, and is stated as UnweightedClass … H of the three debt rows on the local slow strip. Conjoining the two gives the display.
